title: Diagnose a multi-file bug from a bug report

prompt.zh: 请阅读 BUG_REPORT.md，找出并修复结账金额计算的根本原因（可能涉及多个文件），并在 test/ 下为报告中的每个场景补充回归测试。不要引入第三方依赖。完成后运行 `node --test test/` 确认通过，并说明每个根因。
prompt.en: Read BUG_REPORT.md, find and fix the root causes of the wrong checkout totals (more than one file may be involved), and add regression tests under test/ for every scenario in the report. Do not add third-party dependencies. Run `node --test test/` afterwards and explain each root cause.
